display.purpose: Caslon Display for established editorial headings.

body.purpose: Caslon Text prose, left aligned and comfortably spaced.

navigation.purpose: Caslon Text with real italic hover and stable label widths.

utility.purpose: Switzer field labels and supporting text, also with a real italic.

wordmark.purpose: Anvil above BEERMANN, centred in the full viewport.

header-wordmark.purpose: Horizontal anvil + BEERMANN, invisible with dimensions retained only on Home.

footer-wordmark.purpose: Text-only Beermann & Company, without an anvil.

shadows.name: logo-readability
shadows.purpose: Offset shadow beneath the light Home logo over photography.

motion.name: slideshow
motion.purpose: One crossfade every four seconds including fade time, without controls or hover pausing.

narrative.premise: A logo-only photographic Home and five navigation-selected content screens, using Caslon and signature blue.
antiReferences: The retired gradient intro and scroll-driven service reel
Technical monospace labels, frosted navigation and consultancy card grids
Invented clients, institutional scale or performance claims

rules.name: Whole viewport
rules.text: Centre the Home logo in the whole viewport. Open mobile menus occupy separate space above it.

rules.name: Stable navigation
rules.text: Retain the hidden Home header brand's dimensions. Use About, Services, Approach, Expertise and Contact with matching URL fragments.

rules.name: True italic
rules.text: One readable label, invisible sizing copies, real italic faces and no hover underlines.

rules.name: Genuine evidence
rules.text: The employer list concludes the Expertise text in the same column, with body-sized Caslon text and no divider. Explicitly identify previous employers, not clients.

rules.name: Approved images
rules.text: Marbling, sky, gallery, then Hamburg at night. Only marbling and gallery are shaded.

rules.name: Production continuity
rules.text: Preserve real enquiry delivery, legal routes, metadata and the server-side password gate.

components.name: Editorial action
components.description: A restrained text action with real italic hover and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: #305cde; font-family: 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-action:hover { font-style: italic; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 5px; }
